changes.detail: Added tool.pytest.ini_options.pythonpath=[src], so project pytest invocations resolve arenyxa without an external PYTHONPATH override.
Codec operations are now mode-specific: URL/Base64/Hex expose Encode/Decode, JSON exposes Format. Invalid mode-operation pairs fail explicitly instead of silently treating Format as Decode.

Added an independent Professional Suite tab and passive analyzer for host/protocol/status distributions, flow counts, p50/p95/p99 latency, large-transfer findings, host error/latency spikes, plaintext-sensitive metadata detection, bounded evidence timeline and atomic JSON export. Sensitive header values and request bodies are not copied into forensic findings.

Updated the gate to follow the split main_window_navigation.py implementation after the MainWindow modularization, eliminating a false release-blocking failure while keeping current Welcome behavior unchanged.
Changed Traffic Forensics runtime type aliases to typing.Mapping/Sequence so the Windows 7 Python 3.8 frozen compatibility gate remains valid.
